Puzzle Maker

Slice any photo into an N×M tile puzzle: preview the numbered grid, download all tiles as a ZIP or a contact sheet.

Tiles are cut at full resolution. Everything happens in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo.
  2. Set rows and columns with the sliders — the numbered preview updates live.
  3. Click "Download tiles (ZIP)" for individual pieces, or "Download contact sheet" for one overview PNG.
  4. Reassemble, print, or share your puzzle!

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the tiles named and ordered?

Tiles are cut from your photo at full resolution and zipped as puzzle-r1-c1.png style files, numbered in the preview so you know the order.

How many tiles can I make?

Up to 8 × 8 (64 tiles). The preview shows every tile numbered.

Is my photo uploaded?

Yes — slicing happens on a canvas in your browser; the photo is never uploaded.
